Text.Text: I am Captain Teral Voss, and I command the city's defense. Officer Venn counts what comes at our walls, and it is my job to make it stop coming. I have work for anyone who can fight.
The city pays its defenders, and today that is you. Here is your pay. When you are ready, ask me what holds their line together, because that is the next job.
You are back, and my scouts say the Neo-Crusader line has gaps in it. Did you kill all ten Vanguards?

The Neo-Crusaders hold the Ruined Garrison outside the city. It was ours once, and now every raid on Eshan City forms up behind its walls. I want to start with the Vanguards who hold their front line. I need you to kill ten Neo-Crusader Vanguards in the Ruined Garrison or the Winter Marches, then come back to me here.
Good. Kill ten Neo-Crusader Vanguards in the Ruined Garrison or the Winter Marches on Eshan, then come back to me here.
We did not lose it in a fight. It was abandoned three years ago by people who thought the war was over, and the Neo-Crusaders walked in. Nobody asked my opinion at the time.
You still need to kill ten Neo-Crusader Vanguards in the Ruined Garrison or the Winter Marches on Eshan. Come back to me when it is done.
Good work. Here is your pay. All that is left in that garrison now is its command, so ask me who commands it when you are ready.
You are back, and their wounded are staying wounded, which is new. Did you kill six Field Medics and six Heavy Gunners?

Their Field Medics and their Heavy Gunners hold it together. A Vanguard we wound is back on the wall within a day because of the medics, and the gunners protect the medics while they work. I need you to kill six Neo-Crusader Field Medics and six Neo-Crusader Heavy Gunners in the Ruined Garrison or the Battlegrounds, then come back to me here.
Good. Kill six Neo-Crusader Field Medics and six Neo-Crusader Heavy Gunners in the Ruined Garrison or the Battlegrounds on Eshan, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill six Neo-Crusader Field Medics and six Neo-Crusader Heavy Gunners in the Ruined Garrison or the Battlegrounds on Eshan. Come back to me when it is done.
After the line, we go after the medics and gunners who keep it standing. First finish killing the ten Neo-Crusader Vanguards I asked you for.
For the first time in three years I can look at that wall and not count rifles on it. You have the city's thanks and its pay. They will try to retake it, so I now pay for garrison patrols.
You are back, and the garrison banners are down. The Neo-Crusaders are pulling back into the Marches. Did you kill all five Captains?

Five Captains command it. They do not agree with each other, which is the only reason the city still stands. Without them the garrison is a ruin full of soldiers with no orders. I need you to kill five Neo-Crusader Captains in the Ruined Garrison or the Battlegrounds, then come back to me here.
Good. Kill five Neo-Crusader Captains in the Ruined Garrison or the Battlegrounds on Eshan, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill five Neo-Crusader Captains in the Ruined Garrison or the Battlegrounds on Eshan. Come back to me when it is done.
After that, we go after the Captains who command the garrison. First finish killing the six Field Medics and six Heavy Gunners I asked you for.
I respected those soldiers, and I still paid to have it done. That is what defending a city costs. Here is your pay.
You are back, and the eastern side of the Battlegrounds has gone quiet. Did you kill all eight Thyrsian Exiles?

Thyrsian Exiles are out there. They followed Revan once and now they follow nobody. They fight the Neo-Crusaders, they fight us, and they fight better than either. I cannot hold the wall against two enemies. I need you to kill eight Thyrsian Exiles in the Battlegrounds, then come back to me here.
Good. Kill eight Thyrsian Exiles in the Battlegrounds on Eshan, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill eight Thyrsian Exiles in the Battlegrounds on Eshan. Come back to me when it is done.
Here is the patrol rate. The Marches will need another patrol tomorrow, so come back whenever you want the work again.
You are back with snow on your boots. Did you kill ten Scouts and ten Hunters on your patrol?

It does, and the work never runs out. The Neo-Crusaders replace their losses in the Winter Marches quickly, so we have to keep killing them just as quickly. For each patrol I need you to kill ten Neo-Crusader Scouts and ten Neo-Crusader Hunters in the Winter Marches, then come back to me for the patrol rate.
Good. Kill ten Neo-Crusader Scouts and ten Neo-Crusader Hunters in the Winter Marches on Eshan, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Neo-Crusader Scouts and ten Neo-Crusader Hunters in the Winter Marches on Eshan. Come back to me when it is done.
Here is the standing rate. The offer stands for as long as they keep coming back, so return whenever you want the work.
You are back from the garrison. Did you kill ten Vanguards and ten Heavy Gunners on your patrol?

They will keep trying, and I do not have the soldiers to hold it myself. So I pay a standing rate to make sure they never sit there comfortably. For each patrol I need you to kill ten Neo-Crusader Vanguards and ten Neo-Crusader Heavy Gunners in the Ruined Garrison, then come back to me for your pay.
Good. Kill ten Neo-Crusader Vanguards and ten Neo-Crusader Heavy Gunners in the Ruined Garrison on Eshan, then come back to me here.
You still need to kill ten Neo-Crusader Vanguards and ten Neo-Crusader Heavy Gunners in the Ruined Garrison on Eshan. Come back to me when it is done.
Nine days. I was going to write ten in the report, so she was right about me. Thank you, and here is something for the walk.
You are back from the Quartermaster. How many days of rations did she say the wall has?

I need a question carried. I have to know how many days of rations the wall has left, and Quartermaster Ysa Morn will not answer a runner in uniform because she says we round her numbers up. I need you to ask her for the ration count here in the district, then come back and tell me her answer.
Good. Go and speak to Quartermaster Ysa Morn in Eshan City's Silver Gate District, then come back to me with the answer.
You still need to speak to Quartermaster Ysa Morn in Eshan City's Silver Gate District. Come back to me once you have.
Goodbye, Captain. Hold the wall.
What other work do you have for the city's defense?
Yes, all ten Vanguards are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll do it. I will kill ten Neo-Crusader Vanguards.
Not right now. That sounds like a siege.
Why did the city lose the garrison?
How do you plan to stop the raids on the city?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Neo-Crusader Vanguards.
Yes, six medics and six gunners are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. Six Field Medics and six Heavy Gunners.
Not right now. Breaking the line was enough for me.
What is holding the Neo-Crusader line together?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Neo-Crusader Field Medics.
What comes after breaking their front line?
Yes, all five Captains are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. I will kill five Neo-Crusader Captains.
Not right now. That is enough war for me.
Who commands the Neo-Crusaders in the garrison?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Neo-Crusader Captains.
What comes after the field hospital job?
Yes, all eight Thyrsian Exiles are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll take the job. I will kill eight Thyrsian Exiles.
Not right now. The Exiles have lost enough already.
Who else is fighting out on the Battlegrounds?
Still working on it.
Remind me what you need done about the Thyrsian Exiles.
Yes, ten Scouts and ten Hunters are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll patrol the Marches. Ten Scouts and ten Hunters.
Not today. Maybe another time.
Does the city pay for patrols of the Winter Marches?
Still working on it.
Remind me what the Winter Marches patrol involves.
Yes, ten Vanguards and ten Heavy Gunners are dead.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll patrol the garrison. Ten Vanguards and ten Heavy Gunners.
Not right now. Maybe another time.
Will the Neo-Crusaders try to retake the garrison?
Still working on it.
Remind me what the garrison patrol involves.
She said exactly nine days, and not to round it up.
I will come back.
On my way.
I'll ask the Quartermaster for the ration count.
Not right now. I am not a runner.
Do you need a message carried to the Quartermaster?
Still working on it.
Remind me why you sent me to Quartermaster Ysa Morn.
